title: OpenArt app user (subset of POST /suite/api/user/my-info)
description: Field names observed in the my-info response (crawl/loggedin_billing/evidence_api_samples_REDACTED.json): id (= uid = Stripe customer id), email, account_created_at, provider. The cohort generator emits this subset so audience-sync has an email source for non-paying users. Production values are personal data.
